name: FB-88
description: FB-88 was the designation of a Pelta-class frigate that served within the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. At one point, FB-88 flew by a celestial body along with a contingent of nine V-19 Torrent starfighters. FB-88 was painted in a red livery on the central ridges and edges, along with the bridge and areas in the aft section. Additionally, two golden stripes were painted on the dorsal port and starboard hull. The frigate was equipped with at least two dual laser cannon turrets near the rear by its bridge, at least two frontal cannons, and at least one sublight engine.

data.name: FB-88
armament: At least two dual laser cannon turrets
